issues.description: Step indicator shows 'STEP 3 OF 4' but this is step-5. Should show 'STEP 3 OF 4' or the correct step number for the budget screen.
issues.root_cause: apps/web/app/design/step-5/page.tsx likely has a hardcoded or incorrectly computed step value being passed to the progress/header component. The stepNumber prop is likely set to 3 instead of the correct value for step-5.

issues.description: Continue button is not visible anywhere on the screen. Expected behavior requires a Continue button to proceed from budget selection.
issues.root_cause: The Continue button may be rendered below the card carousel but the layout/overflow is hiding it, or it may be conditionally rendered only after a selection is made but no card appears selected by default.

issues.description: Only 2 budget tier cards are partially visible in a horizontal swipe layout. Expected 4-5 cards (Essential, Elevated, Refined, Prestige, Signature). The carousel/swipe UX hides most cards and may not be the intended stacked card layout.
issues.root_cause: The cards are implemented as a horizontal swipe carousel showing one card at a time, which only shows 1-2 cards. The expected behavior describes multiple visible cards. The container may have overflow:hidden with a flex row layout limiting visibility.
